alerts.title: Paving Operations-149890
alerts.description: Between Exit 133: Dotsero (near Gypsum) and US 6 (near Eagle) from Mile Point 139 to Mile Point 147. Right lane closed due to paving operations. Width limit in effect. Width limit 11'0". Starting October 22, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 22, 2026 at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 22, 7:00AM - October 22, 7:00PM Comment: Eastbound and westbound Eagle (Exit 147) and Gypsum (Exit 140) on/off ramp lane shifts. Intermittent single lane closures, speed reduced to 55 mph and 10-20 minute delays. For more information email: resurfacingproject@gmail.com.

alerts.title: I-70 Glenwood Canyon Bridge Joint Improvements-148514
alerts.description: Between Exit 125: Hanging Lake and Exit 129: Bair Ranch (4 to 5 miles west of the Dotsero area) from Mile Point 127 to Mile Point 128. Right lane closed due to bridge construction. Starting October 22, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 22, 2026 at about 7:01PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 22, 7:00AM - October 22, 7:01PM Comment: Eastbound and westbound lane width restrictions, for commercial and recreational vehicles, are in effect 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A commercial and recreational vehicle width limit of 11'-0" is in place for the duration of the project. Eastbound I-70 will be reduced to one lane from Mile Point 127 to 128. Westbound from Mile Point 125 to 126 on the east side of Hanging Lake Tunnel will be one-lane for bridge joint water testing. Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday. The speed limit will be reduced to 35 mph through the work zone.
